title: Kits and step patterns export one clip per hit, named by pad
description:
As a beatmaker, I want kits and step patterns exported one clip per hit, named by pad, so that a flipped break is editable hit by hit in the DAW.

```gherkin
Feature: Kits and step patterns in the set
  Background:
    Given the sample "brk.wav" with a steady beat at 90 BPM
    And the samples "kick.wav" and "snare.wav" with one hit each

  Scenario: A sliced kit plays one clip per step
    Given the score "flip.apr":
      """
      tempo 90
      key C
      clip brk = brk.wav beats 0..4
      kit b = slice brk by beats 1
      bars 1
      track b transpose 0 steps "1 . 3 4" grid 4
      """
    When I export "flip.apr" as a DAW set
    Then the track "b" has 3 clips named "b.1", "b.3", "b.4"
    And they start at beats 0, 2 and 3 and each lasts 1 beat
    And each plays its own slice of "brk.wav"

  Scenario: A drum kit's pads come from different samples
    Given a drum kit "drums" with pads "kick" from "kick.wav" and "snare" from "snare.wav"
    And the track "drums" plays steps "kick . snare ."
    When I export the score as a DAW set
    Then the clips of "drums" are named "kick" and "snare"
    And they refer to "kick.wav" and "snare.wav"

  Scenario: Swing, humanize and velocity land as compiled
    Given the track "b" has "swing 60", "humanize 10ms 20%" and a ghost note "3@40"
    When I export the score as a DAW set
    Then every clip of "b" starts where the compiled timeline starts its note
    And the ghost note's clip is quieter by the ghost note's level
```
